fields.incidentName: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur
fields.objective: Confirm the valve position at the dome and close it if safe, then report.
fields.hazards: Corrosive liquid and vapor; shipping paper gives the product name. Container pressure unknown.
fields.monitoring: Abort on a monitor reading above the agreed action level, a wind shift toward the team, loss of radio contact, or one team member at half air.
